description: Creating the minutes draft from the template: status, existing minutes and sources.
precondition: Meeting in progress or ended; secretary actor.

preconditions: Ended meeting with Chair and Secretary assigned.
No minutes exist for the meeting.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.
cases.return: New Draft revision 1 with content built from the records and the reviewed draft; BuiltFromDraftAt = the draft change time; 201 MSG395.
cases.log: Saved: minutes row (Draft, revision 1) with template content, BuiltFromDraftAt and creation time; realtime minutes-changed push to the meeting's readers.
cases.note: UC-59 · MSG395 · Deviation: success also emits a realtime minutes-changed push (working-tree change).

preconditions: Ended meeting the actor can read.
Actor is an ordinary Member (neither Chair nor Secretary).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the Member; rebuild: false.
meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.
cases.return: Failure Exists; 409 MSG399; the existing draft is unchanged.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: true.
cases.return: Failure Locked; 409 MSG400; a sent revision is refused even with rebuild.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
The database fails while saving the new draft.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.
cases.log: Error logged with the meeting id.
